The '''Old Trade Federation Route''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route once used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. It passed through the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim's]] [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] and the [[Enmaekeda Nebula]], a tumultuous ball of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] matter home to [[Borvo]]'s thugs. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] claimed the route unsafe and restricted travel to all parties.

==History==
After the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the route was no longer used. Some time between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it was taken over by the [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] criminal [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|empire]].
